context: Two teens trade rumors from school after class
purpose: Teach: 次元/語ら/有る/迅速/ものすごい/左手/一家/よほど

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、聞いた？三組の田中くん、ものすごい秘密が有るらしいよ。
lines.en: Hey, did you hear? Tanaka in class three apparently has an incredible secret.
lines.style: Excited gossipy whisper, leaning in close with wide curious eyes.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: またその話か。お前、噂を広めるのだけは迅速だよな。
lines.en: That story again? You're only ever quick when it comes to spreading rumors.
lines.style: Teasing flat tone with a small smirk and slight eye-roll.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うるさいな。でも本当なんだって。田中くんの一家、実は次元が違うお金持ちなの。
lines.en: Oh shut up. But it's really true. The Tanaka family is actually wealthy on another dimension.
lines.style: Defensive then dramatic, voice rising with conspiratorial intensity.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: へえ、よほど自信あるんだな、その情報に。
lines.en: Wow, you must be really confident about that piece of information.
lines.style: Skeptical drawl, arms crossed and one eyebrow raised.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 美咲が見たんだって。田中くん、左手にすごく高そうな時計してたって。
lines.en: Misaki saw it. Tanaka was wearing a really expensive-looking watch on his left hand.
lines.style: Triumphant tone, gesturing with hands to demonstrate the watch.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 時計一個でそこまで語られるのか、あいつも可哀想に。
lines.en: He gets discussed that much just from one watch? Poor guy, honestly.
lines.style: Mock-sympathetic sigh with a slow shake of the head.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 可哀想じゃないよ、羨ましいの！私もそんな家に生まれたかった〜。
lines.en: It's not pity, it's envy! I wish I'd been born into a house like that too.
lines.style: Whiny mock-complaint with exaggerated pouting and theatrical flopping.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: はいはい。じゃあ俺、部活あるから帰るわ。また明日な。
lines.en: Yeah yeah. Anyway, I've got club practice, so I'm heading out. See you tomorrow.
lines.style: Dismissive but friendly, shouldering bag while turning to leave casually.
